title: Cameras software versions MV 7.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Tue, 13 Jan 2026
A new stable camera firmware is now available on Thu, 12 Mar 2026

New: Added support for Video Clips API
Bug fixes: Resolved an issue on MV84 series cameras where a short recording disruption could occur immediately after a firmware upgrade.
Resolved an issue where privacy windows might not appear on the video stream when using Standard video quality settings on MV84X
General: Improvements to video recording stability on MV84X
Improvements to Image Quality for MV84X
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15
MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches

html:
Cameras software versions MV 7.2 changelog

New

  • Added support for Video Clips API

  • Added support for Rapid Review

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue on MV84 series cameras where a short recording disruption could occur immediately after a firmware upgrade.

  • Resolved an issue where privacy windows might not appear on the video stream when using Standard video quality settings on MV84X

  • General security and stability improvements

General

  • Improvements to video recording stability on MV84X

  • Improvements to Image Quality for MV84X

Notice

  • When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15

  • MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches
